name: Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa
description: The most magnificent and prestigious hotel at the Disneyland Resort — Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa is a breathtaking Arts and Crafts-style resort hotel inspired by the great lodges of the American West, featuring a stunning six-story atrium lobby, direct private entrance to Disney California Adventure, multiple award-winning restaurants including Napa Rose, a spectacular pool complex and some of the finest theming of any hotel in North America.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegantly themed Arts and Crafts room with garden or courtyard views.

rooms.name: Pool View Room
rooms.description: Premium room overlooking the spectacular Redwood Pool complex.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Magnificent suite with private balcony and complimentary breakfast.

name: Disneyland Hotel
description: The original Disney hotel and a Southern California landmark since 1955 — the Disneyland Hotel is a beloved classic resort hotel adjacent to the Downtown Disney District featuring elaborately themed rooms, multiple pools, character dining and the longest history of any Disney hotel in the world. One of the most nostalgic and cherished Disney resort hotels.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Beautifully Disney-themed room with courtyard or garden views.

rooms.name: Magic Kingdom Tower Room
rooms.description: Premium tower room with Disneyland Resort views.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with resort views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Disney's Pixar Place Hotel
description: A vibrant Pixar-themed hotel at the Disneyland Resort — Pixar Place Hotel features elaborate Pixar character theming throughout, multiple pools, Pixar character dining and convenient access to both Disneyland and Disney California Adventure. The most fun and family-friendly hotel at the Disneyland Resort.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Fun Pixar-themed room with resort or courtyard views.

rooms.name: Pool View Room
rooms.description: Room with pool views and Pixar character decor.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious Pixar suite with separate living area and breakfast.

name: Anaheim Marriott
description: One of Anaheim's finest and most well-regarded hotels — the Anaheim Marriott is a prestigious 4-star hotel just 10 minutes walk from Disneyland, offering elegant rooms, a spectacular pool, multiple restaurants, a full fitness centre and some of the best non-Disney hotel service in Anaheim. Excellent value compared to on-site Disney hotels.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegant 4-star room with city or pool views and free WiFi.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Premium room with upgraded furnishings and Anaheim views.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with panoramic views and complimentary breakfast.
